title: DIO time verifier parses noncanonical bare DIO instead of authenticated L2 envelope
description: Correctness review: DioTimeVerifier passes RxFrame.payload directly to DIO.from_bytes, but authenticated routing/control L2 payloads begin with dispatch 0x15 (or SCHC dispatch before decompression). Tests sign a noncanonical bare DIO. Parse the canonical authenticated L2/RPL envelope or consume a nonforgeable verified parser result, require DIO code/type, retain the raw authenticated payload and exact option span, and add literal signed on-wire dispatch vectors.
